items.title: Bajet 2027 bentang 9 Oktober letak nombor besar untuk startup: RM450 juta dilabur Jelawang
items.text:
Bajet 2027 bentang 9 Oktober letak nombor besar untuk startup: RM450 juta dilabur Jelawang Capital (Khazanah) dan Dana Perintis (KWAP).

RM270 juta lagi untuk tarik modal swasta lewat ECF dan P2P, RM41 juta untuk Cradle Fund, dan pengecualian cukai pelabur angel dilanjutkan sehingga 2030.

Wang awam masuk dulu, baru modal swasta nak ikut.

#StartupMY

items.title: Adakah modal venture di Malaysia tengah naik atau sekadar cerita?
items.text:
Adakah modal venture di Malaysia tengah naik atau sekadar cerita?

Laporan H1 2026 jawab soalan itu: startup tempatan kutip US$203 juta merentas 27 deals pada separuh pertama 2026, naik 34% berbanding tahun lalu. Bahagian Malaysia dalam jumlah deals serantau juga melonjak dari sekitar 3% ke sekitar 20%.

MAVCAP pula co-invest dalam 9 daripada 27 deals itu.

Modal swasta mula yakin dengan Kuala Lumpur.

#VentureMY

items.title: Cradle baru lancarkan Malaysia Top 100 Startups 2026: 100 startup teknologi teratas negara
items.text:
Cradle baru lancarkan Malaysia Top 100 Startups 2026: 100 startup teknologi teratas negara jana RM8.5 bilion revenue untuk FY2024, dengan purata CAGR 87% dari 2021 hingga 2024. 33 daripadanya pernah dapat dana Cradle.

Tapi realitinya: 5,013 startup berdaftar di MYStartup setakat Ogos 2026, dan hanya 12% startup berdaftar dari 2019 hingga 2024 yang berjaya dapat funding.

Ramai yang wujud, sedikit yang dapat modal. Itu cabaran seterusnya.

#StartupMY

Use-Case Research Notes - 2026-11-14 (Sat, 15:00 +08)

Engine run (last30days v3.26.0, LAW-7 plan via --plan tmpfile)

  • Topic: "Hermes Agent viral use cases and workflows" (named entity)
  • Result: 62 items - Reddit 20 threads (551 upv, 242 cmt), HN 22 stories (2,438 pts), GitHub 20 items. Runtime 116.8s.
  • PARTIAL COVERAGE: active sources only reddit/hackernews/polymarket/github (no X auth, no yt-dlp, no ScrapeCreators key, no browser cookies). Polymarket 0 relevant markets. YouTube missing. Reddit search lane hit HTTP 403 (keyless arctic-shift backfill covered). Treat as partial.
  • Notable engine evidence: r/hermesagent "Absolutely Wild" (402 pts, 2026-11-13, IT director let Hermes stand up a full Wi-Fi network); "Hermit" bot-forward app (22 pts); "Herm" macOS app (50 pts); Sidecar Office sidebar hackathon (37 pts); HN "Hermes and REA and GLM 5.3 = reverse engineering TikTok <$20"; NousResearch/hermes-agent ~255k stars claim (simple-icons #15092); hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-stories (home security for grandfather via Home Assistant+Zigbee, WhatsApp budget bot, research agent delivering daily briefs to Discord/Slack/Notion/Obsidian, GTM TAM builder).

Web supplements (Step 2, sourced)

  • LLM cost tracking: llmtee self-hosted cost proxy released 2026-11-11 (sourcebento.com/news/llmtee-offers-self-hosted-llm-cost-tracking-and-budget-caps); github.com/Dominic6018/ai-api-cost-tracker (budgets+alerts+reconcile vs provider bills); genaihub.net/agents/n8n-22244 (per-workflow LLM spend -> Telegram/Slack alert every 15 min); docs.datadoghq.com LLM cost observability.
  • Reading queue / newsletter digest: github.com/yannikbauer/obsidian-ai-os guide/everyday.md (newsletter-digest + job-digest skills, read-only subagents, weekly note, keep/unsubscribe verdict); reddit.com/r/ObsidianMD/comments/1x9rk23 (scheduled agent maintains daily notes, tags, weekly review, 07:00 daily + Monday weekly).
  • Property watch MY: propertyguru.com.my/alerts-landing (daily email alerts for saved searches); apify.com/abotapi/propertyguru-my-scraper (incremental mode for daily monitoring, sort by date, state Putrajaya available); apify.com/fatihtahta/iproperty-scraper (scheduled runs).
  • Marketplace seller ops: fous.com/automate/shopee-seller-centre (daily 08:00 return/refund due list; weekday 10:00 to-ship with deadline today/tomorrow; Monday 09:00 weekly released income to accounting); atsell.io/ai-automation (AI agents for Shopee/Lazada/TikTok Shop ops: statement matching, restock calc, voucher recalc); luma.com/hebjrafo (Run Your Shopee Store with Claude workshop: dashboard + stock forecast).
  • Gov tender MY: apify.com/jungle_synthesizer/myprocurement-malaysia-government-tender-scraper (MOF MyProcurement myprocurement.treasury.gov.my, tender/quotation advert+result, kategori Kerja/Bekalan/Perkhidmatan, Kod Bidang CIDB, closing_date, estimated_value_rm, no login); biddetail.com/malaysia-tenders (aggregates eperolehan.gov.my JKR/CIDB/MOF/MINDEF).
  • Also considered & rejected for overlap w/ history: backup/SSL/domain guardian (sources: Shineori/homelab restic+Backrest 2026-11-10, eon.io 3-2-1-1-0 + PocketOS incident, apify.com/tudorlane/domain-watch, uptimerobot.com) - parked; meeting scheduler (r/AI_Agents 1wyt5rc, resident.com Lindy/Clara) - parked; expense splitter (hipposplit.com) - parked.

Covered domains already delivered: morning digest, price watcher, sysadmin watchdog (ports/disk/RAM), research watcher cron, dreaming digest, content factory, live status PWA, bill negotiator, health companion, job-hunt watcher, travel concierge, smart home bridge, voice-note command, shadow-audit, video->shorts, local LLM privacy, contract triage, client DM copilot, BM tutor, subscription ledger, meeting action items, anti-scam family, WhatsApp biz responder, second-brain Q&A, scout->mini-app, weekly review, quote/invoice, meal planner, commute audio briefing, parcel tracker, doc expiry sentinel, pre-ship code review, inbox zero coach, xmas gift hunter, habit coach, sell-anything listing, tax relief vault, personal CRM, photo librarian, CVE watcher, HIBP sentinel, year in review.

Selected 5 (NEW, buildable on April's system, sourced):

  1. LLM spend sentinel (agent self-ops cost) - NEW vs sysadmin watchdog (live metrics only)
  2. Reading-queue curator (Saved Messages/RSS/Pocket -> weekly digest -> Obsidian) - NEW vs inbox coach (replies) & morning digest (personal inbox summary)
  3. Property hunt watcher MY (PropertyGuru/iProperty scrape, new listings + price drop) - NEW vs travel concierge (flights/hotels)
  4. Marketplace seller ops hub (Shopee/Lazada to-ship/returns/low-stock/income) - NEW vs WhatsApp responder (client chat) & sell-anything (listing drafts)
  5. Gov tender scout MY (MyProcurement/eTender, Services/ICT, closing <14d) - NEW vs job-hunt watcher (job boards)

All builds require "Approve Boss" before any cron/system change (standing rule).
